name: Bound by Misery
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 3, bard 3, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 3, lathspell 3, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D); see text
Saving Throw Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to be overwhelmed with such sadness that they grab themselves and sob uncontrollably. Each round at the beginning of their turn the target must make a grapple attempt or an attempt to maintain a grapple against themselves. If the target is grappled by themselves during the round, they cannot move. The target cannot elect to release the grapple as a free action. Each round at the end of its turn, the target can attempt a Will save to end the spell.

Bound by Misery, Mass

School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 8, mesmerist 6, psychic 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch .

Targets one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as bound by misery except that it affects multiple creatures as noted above.
